name: a colleague's commit outside the scope arrives by pull, by merge, by pull --rebase and by fetch and rebase; the front goes on and closes

steps.command: git clone -q . @SCRATCH@/up && (cd @SCRATCH@/up && git config user.email c@c && git config user.name colleague && echo 'b = 7' > outside/b.py && git commit -q -am 'a colleague, outside this scope')
(cd @SCRATCH@/up && echo 'b = 8' > outside/b.py && echo 'a = 9' > src/a.py && git commit -q -am 'the colleague again, both files')
(cd @SCRATCH@/up && git pull -q --no-rebase @T@ main && echo 'b = 10' > outside/b.py && git commit -q -am 'the colleague, a third time')
git commit -q -am 'mine again, before a rebase'
(cd @SCRATCH@/up && git pull -q --no-rebase @T@ main && echo 'b = 11' > outside/b.py && git commit -q -am 'the colleague, a fourth time')

steps.new_string: and on, and on, and on

steps.command: git commit -q -am 'mine, before a fetch and a rebase'
git fetch -q @SCRATCH@/up main && git rebase -q FETCH_HEAD
